checks: Conditioning on the other phases makes W atomless by pY_p. Positivity of its positive event, finiteness of W_+, and integrability of each old phase are immediate from independence and finite means.

At fixed old variables, v=W-aY_* has conditional density a^{-1} exp((v-W)/a) 1_{v<W}. At zero, weighted old-index and new-index densities therefore give the displayed moment formulas. Boundary assignments at W=0 are immaterial.

Dominated convergence applies to J_a, to Y_i weights, and to the weighted positive part. The scaled cap probability tends to E(W_+)=PM while F_a tends to zero, so each stated scaled gap converges without presupposing a finite-a inequality.
Exact check on the empty-negative old list: W is always positive, P=1, M=p+q and all nu_i=1, giving zero leading gap. Also F_a=1-[(1+p/a)(1+q/a)]^{-1}, confirming a F_a -> p+q.

dependencies.mapping: Use the (N-1)-simplex of normalized old phases. Independence of the gamma sum gives barycentric cap centroid nu_i/N; each coordinate is positive because P>0 and old phases are almost surely strictly positive. The cap indicator is feasible in T_K at that centroid, and the energy formula divided by full simplex volume is prod_i nu_i. This includes the case P=1.
